$ ergon init upgrade --help
Usage: ergon init upgrade [options]

Move the repository to the baseline of the newest release of ergon.

ergon init upgrade moves the repository to the baseline of the newest release
of ergon: the highest release of go.dokimi.dev/ergon that the first module
proxy of GOPROXY that is a URL lists, of the major version of this ergon, or of
any major version with --major. When it is newer than this ergon, the command
installs it into the cache of ergon tool run, checks its archive against the
checksums.txt of the release, and runs its ergon init upgrade, whose exit
status it returns.

The newest release runs ergon init sync, and then prints each pin of
.ergon.yaml whose version differs from the baseline. A build of ergon without a
release runs the upgrade itself, and refuses a lock that a release wrote. A
release refuses a lock that such a build wrote.

Options:
      --force  Overwrite the managed files that were edited by hand.  env ERGON_INIT_UPGRADE_FORCE
      --major  Take a release of a later major version.               env ERGON_INIT_UPGRADE_MAJOR

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env ERGON_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
      --version     Show the version.
[exit 0]

$ ergon init ci --help
Usage: ergon init ci <command> [options]

Run the job of the workflow baseline.yml.

ergon init ci runs the job of the workflow baseline.yml in GitHub Actions.

Commands:
  upgrade  Upgrade ergon and open the pull request of the change.

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env ERGON_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
      --version     Show the version.
[exit 0]

$ ergon init ci
Usage: ergon init ci <command> [options]

Run the job of the workflow baseline.yml.

ergon init ci runs the job of the workflow baseline.yml in GitHub Actions.

Commands:
  upgrade  Upgrade ergon and open the pull request of the change.

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env ERGON_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
      --version     Show the version.

ergon: init ci: missing command
[exit 2]

$ ergon init ci upgrade --help
Usage: ergon init ci upgrade [options]

Upgrade ergon and open the pull request of the change.

ergon init ci upgrade upgrades the repository as ergon init upgrade does. When
the sync changes a file, it writes a changeset without packages, commits the
changes on the branch ergon-baseline/<base> through the API of GitHub, which
signs the commits, and opens or updates the pull request into the base branch
of .changeset/config.json. The exit status is 1 after it proposed the files of a
sync that left a managed file that was edited by hand.

Options:
      --force  Overwrite the managed files that were edited by hand.  env ERGON_INIT_CI_UPGRADE_FORCE
      --major  Take a release of a later major version.               env ERGON_INIT_CI_UPGRADE_MAJOR

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env ERGON_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
      --version     Show the version.
[exit 0]
